name: mariam-shop
description: Site vitrine et plateforme d'annonces de MARIAM SHOP (Mali) — Cloudflare Workers + fichiers statiques, D1, R2, Turnstile

scripts.dev: npm run build && npx wrangler dev --port 8788
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:init:local: npx wrangler d1 execute mariam-shop-db --local --file=./schema.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute mariam-shop-db --local --file=./seed.sql
scripts.db:init:remote: npx wrangler d1 execute mariam-shop-db --remote --file=./schema.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute mariam-shop-db --remote --file=./seed.sql
